assets.name: hud-background
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production game UI asset, NOT a screenshot/mockup. One wide rectangular Chinese xianxia cultivation HUD backing panel, width to height 3:1, no text, no portrait, no bars, no symbols. Polished ink painting and antique jade aesthetic. Warm ivory silk parchment center, softly painted blue green immortal mountains and cloud wisps near bottom right, aged pale gold filigree cloud corners, narrow jade carved edge. All frame fully inside canvas with 3 percent transparent safety gutter on all four sides. Central upper and middle area calm ivory with very faint paper texture for legible black live UI text. This is backing behind player avatar and health bars, restrained expensive fairy cultivation art. True transparent outside frame only. Crisp 2D orthographic UI illustration.

assets.name: button-states
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production Chinese xianxia game UI sprite atlas on TRUE transparent background, not a screenshot. Exact 2 columns x 2 rows equal grid. Each cell has a complete horizontal rectangular button 3.5:1 ratio centered with equal 6 percent transparent padding, no cropping, no text, no icons. Top left NORMAL: warm ivory jade plaque with thin engraved antique gold border, subtle cloud curl corner decorations, light pale celadon brushwash. Top right SELECTED: rich deep jade teal enamel plaque with ornate luminous antique gold cloud rim and calm dark center suitable for ivory text. Bottom left HOVER: lighter luminous ivory celadon plaque with softly glowing gold cloud rim. Bottom right PRESSED: muted deep jade enamel plaque with recessed gold rim. Consistent same silhouette, same exact frame size and identical aligned margins in all cells, crisp refined traditional Chinese immortal cultivation theme, functional clean center for UI labels, no large halos touching cell boundaries.

assets.name: status-bars
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production Chinese xianxia game HUD resource bar atlas. EXACT ONE COLUMN and SIX ROWS of equal sized cells on true transparent background, each cell wide 8:1 horizontal bar, centered with 4 percent transparent safety gutter. No text, numerals, labels, watermark. Rows 1 2 3 are THREE EMPTY TRACK BACKGROUNDS for health, cultivation, shield: refined thin antique gold ornamental cloud frame with ivory jade endcaps, narrow dark teal recessed inner channel occupying middle 84 percent width and central 42 percent height. Frames identical shape and proportions, restrained red/jade/ice accents respectively. Rows 4 5 6 are corresponding THREE SEPARATE BORDERLESS FILL STRIPS: ruby red flowing cinnabar energy, emerald jade flowing qi energy, luminous ice blue shield energy. Fill strips have only flowing silk cloud texture, no end ornaments, no frame, no gold outlines; occupy middle 84 percent width and central 42 percent height of each cell exactly where channels are. Fully include all 6 strips without cropping. Refined immortal cultivation antique jade gold visual style, horizontal clear readable meter, consistent precise aligned cells.

cultivation_icon: Use case: stylized-concept. Create one production Chinese immortal cultivation game UI icon, a serene cross-legged meditator silhouette surrounded by complete flowing golden flame aura and jade-gold lotus base. Premium detailed gold ornament and teal jade aesthetic matching xianxia UI, crisp illustrated 2D orthographic. Entire shape including flame tip and outer aura must fit completely in a centered square silhouette occupying only central 70 percent of the canvas, leaving at least 15 percent truly transparent margin on all four sides. No frame, no solid background, no text, no cropped flame or lotus. Transparent background.
